content.value_statement: Drafting email creative can drift from offers, landing pages, and approved claims. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code produce subjects, preheaders, body copy, CTAs, and plain-text alternates tied to source claims.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3 to 5 subject-line variants for one email creative.
Creates a matched preheader, body copy, one CTA, and a plain-text alternate.
Supports promotional, cold-outbound, and newsletter email modes.
Checks claims against provided claim ledgers or marks them as needing a source.
Maps subject, offer, and CTA promises to the destination page for message match.
Produces a handoff summary for testing or quality audit workflows.
limitations: It does not score, rank, or pre-test subject-line variants.
It does not compute email quality scores or run deliverability vetoes.
It needs a destination URL or pasted landing-page copy to enforce message match.
It will not invent statistics, discounts, guarantees, testimonials, or legal claims.

use_cases.title: Launch a promotional email
use_cases.description: Create offer-led subject lines, body copy, one CTA, and claim flags for a single campaign.

use_cases.title: Draft a cold-outbound message
use_cases.description: Write a short relevance-first email using one verifiable personalization signal and a low-pressure ask.

use_cases.title: Prepare newsletter creative
use_cases.description: Turn a topic or sponsor offer into a clear subject promise, editorial body, disclosure, and forwarding ask.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a promo email
prompt_templates.prompt: Build email creative for [offer] in promo mode. Use this destination URL: [URL]. Include subject variants, preheader, body, CTA, and plain-text alternate.

prompt_templates.title: Create a cold email
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cold-outbound email to [persona] for [offer]. Personalize on [verifiable signal], keep one soft ask, and match the CTA to [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Iterate existing creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve these subject lines and body copy: [paste copy]. Keep any strong lines, replace weak ones, and flag every claim that needs a source.

prompt_templates.title: Build audit-ready creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete email creative for [campaign]. Use [mode], [persona], [brand voice], [approved claims], and [destination copy]. Include message-match notes and handoff summary.

output_examples.input: Promo email for a weekend sale with a provided landing page and approved discount terms.
output: Five subject-line options labeled SUBJ-A through SUBJ-E.
A preheader, scannable body, one CTA, and a plain-text alternate.
Message-match notes showing where the offer, promise, and CTA appear on the destination page.

output_examples.input: Cold email to operations leaders using one verified trigger and no approved performance statistic.
output: A short plain-text style email with one relevance line and one soft ask.
Claims without source material marked as needing a source.
A handoff note explaining assumptions and next review steps.

output_examples.input: Newsletter issue with an editorial topic and a paid sponsor section.
output: Subject variants that promise the editorial value clearly.
A body draft with sponsor disclosure kept separate from editorial copy.
A CTA and forwarding ask that do not compete with each other.

best_practices: Provide the destination URL, campaign mode, audience, brand voice, and approved claims before drafting.
Keep one primary CTA and make sure the landing page delivers the same promise.
Review all source flags before sending, especially prices, discounts, statistics, guarantees, and testimonials.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent missing offer terms or proof points.
Do not use it as a replacement for deliverability scoring or compliance review.
Do not test multiple creative variables while treating the result as a subject-line test.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It drafts email creative and handoff notes. Sending remains inside your email platform or workflow.

faq.question: Can it rank the best subject line?
faq.answer: No. It creates variants, but subject-line scoring and test design belong to separate review workflows.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the offer, destination URL, campaign mode, audience, brand voice, and any approved claims or disclosures.

faq.question: Can it write B2B cold email?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports cold-outbound mode with one verifiable personalization signal and a low-pressure ask.

faq.question: How does it handle unsupported claims?
faq.answer: It marks unsupported claims as needing a source instead of inventing proof or silently removing the issue.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible hosts.
